summary: Sandbach United produced a devastating performance against Telford Town, securing an impressive 6-0 away victory with Kyle Foley grabbing a hat-trick and goals from Birchall and Hatton sealing a dominant display. The team showed solid defending for a clean sheet while proving ruthless in attack, with the clinical finishing coming largely in the second half. It was a statement result that demonstrates The Bach's attacking prowess and defensive solidity.
